host.description: Target host (IP address or MAC address); required argument to arping.

arping_opts.description: List of command-line options for arping; each element is a string like '-c 3' or '-i eth0'.

timeout_sec.description: Maximum runtime in seconds for the arping process.

user.description: User to run arping as; must be an existing system user.

group.description: Group to run arping as; must be an existing system group.

nice_value.description: Scheduling priority for arping; negative values increase priority (e.g., -15 for low-latency timing).

capabilities.description: List of Linux capabilities to retain after dropping root (e.g., ['CAP_NET_RAW']).
